usage: 千克 is a noun used to measure weight.
It is a standard unit for weighing heavier objects compared to grams.
千克 can be used alone or with numbers to specify weight amounts.
In daily conversation, people often combine 千克 with food items or goods to discuss quantity.
千克 is more common in formal or semi-formal contexts than informal speech.
